tagline: Technology Enthusiast & DevOps | Platform Engineer | SRE
bio: I am Bilgehan, a passionate technology enthusiast who loves working with platform technologies, especially containerization. I enjoy developing tools that make life easier and diving deep into the details of how technologies work behind the scenes.

Learning and staying up to date with the latest advancements excites me, and I spend a lot of time reading and exploring new concepts. In addition to my tech interests, I also have a passion for RC cars, which adds a fun and hands-on aspect to my hobbies.
